messages.subject: Handling  big .rda files
parts:
Hi,

I've been developing a prediction app for my company, and I'm on the test phase using Shiny Server on an Amazon EC vm. The goal is to mount this on the company's server. 
The problem I have is the following : 
when I run the App locally, everything is smooth. no problem loading my 250MB .rda file, but when run on the Amazon instance, my app just disconnects after hitting the button that triggers the prediction using the model.
I tried a dummy model stored in a small (25MB) .rda file and the App worked correctly. So my question is, Does the free version of Shiny server have a limitation on the size of the files ? and if not, any workaround for this problem ?
